description: Canonical machine-readable topology for runtime systems and agent context tooling (phase-3 route-composer split plus Phase VIII replenishment producer+notification-consumer closure, additive telemetry journaling from websocket ingress through Kafka into Spanner audit storage, retailer cart sync realtime convergence via CART_SYNC_UPDATED post-commit invalidation, retailer AI confirm/reject outbox atomicity plus ORDER_REASSIGNED retailer+supplier fanout parity with admin-portal hybrid invalidation, retailer inbox settlement/session refresh parity with shared ws-event contract coverage, checkout supplier-effective currency resolution, payment-session currency normalization, refund/chargeback additive currency compatibility, treasury/reconciliation read-model currency parity for admin portal consumers, warehouse treasury invoice currency parity across portal and native clients, warehouse analytics additive import anomaly queue projection with portal/native parity, regional degressive checkout fee authority seeded from RegionalConfigs and evaluated through order/fee_policy.go with immutable slice outputs, multitenant driver/factory login disambiguation plus supplier-scoped phone uniqueness in provisioning flows, phase-1 regional substrate plus provider-seam normalization for GLOBAL_PAY/ADYEN/CASH with official Adyen Payment Links hosted-checkout wiring, provider execution-path gateway normalization plus `payment/execution.go` stored-method/direct refund routing for order checkout, fulfillment, authorization, void, and refund call sites, supplier/warehouse region query-scope middleware enforcement, webhook route composition parity for Global Pay, Stripe, and Adyen ingress, settlement-locality bootstrap for MasterInvoices/Warehouses/Vault precedence plus SupplierInventoryV2 warehouse-key inventory schema, supplier inventory import staging substrate and admin-portal wizard shell routing, supplier import alias deprecation plus warehouse-scoped analytics attribution convergence, active InventoryV2 runtime dual-read/write mirroring across checkout/restock plus replenishment and planning read convergence, autonomous nearest-factory routing fallback when no active SupplyLanes candidate exists, checkout warehouse equal-H3 tie round-robin balancing across resolver paths, region-filtered supplier reads and expanded warehouse ops plus demand read surfaces, slog observability tranche across high-noise runtime domains and cache infrastructure paths, local sequential-thinking MCP fallback, targeted workspace retrieval as the default codebase-retrieval path, S-level dynamic billing metering with milestone-driven platform fee adjustments plus treasury billing telemetry, dynamic delivery handshake settlement orchestration with DeliverySessions audit trails, settlement-required fanout, dispute escalation outbox/dispatcher closure, retailer role-row consumption parity, Task 1.4 desktop-to-native verified command handshake lifecycle bridging with Redis-backed ws command registry plus native ACK settlement, and Phase 2.1 websocket envelope guard schema negotiation with guarded downgrade and SYSTEM_APP_OUTDATED fallback).

methods: Spanner schema adds SupplierPayoutPolicies and InvoiceSettlementSlices with additive MasterInvoices fee summary fields

Settlement slices capture gross, fee policy version, fee basis points, fee amount, net payout, and payout owner metadata per supplier slice.

notes: Regional defaults are additive and rollout-safe because legacy flat-bps evaluation remains available when policy version or defaults are absent.

Order split and ledger math now resolve runtime basis points to keep checkout and treasury views aligned with dynamic fee changes.
Spanner schema now includes InventoryImportSessions and interleaved InventoryImportRows with supplier and warehouse filter indexes for staging and review flows.

Phase-2 compatibility substrate also includes SupplierImportSessions, interleaved SupplierImportStagedRows, and SupplierImportMapping keyed by supplier_id/session_id for strict supplier data isolation.

Phase-6 atomic apply now processes /v1/supplier/inventory/imports/{id}/apply via ApplyImportSession with supplier ownership checks, APPROVED|APPLYING state gate, approved-row filtering, additive is_new_product catalog upsert into SupplierProducts, dual-write quantity mutations to SupplierInventory + SupplierInventoryV2, InventoryAuditLog journaling with BULK_IMPORT, idempotent APPLIED completion, and FAILED + error_summary fallback on non-conflict failures.

Phase-7 freshness wiring now emits websocket INVENTORY_SYNC_COMPLETE frames after apply commit in suppliercoreroutes/imports.go, fanning out to both SupplierHub and affected WarehouseHub channels with session_id, rows_affected, timestamp, and additive warehouse/product identifiers for immediate role-row refresh.

Phase-3 signed-upload bridge now issues deterministic GCS PUT tickets (imports/{supplier_id}/{session_id}/raw.xlsx), writes SupplierImportSessions in INITIALIZED status pre-ingress, enforces a 50MB upload-size gate, and exposes POST /v1/supplier/inventory/imports/{id}/uploaded to transition UPLOADED + emit outbox INVENTORY_IMPORT_UPLOADED on inventory.import.events.

Phase-4 AI mapping worker now consumes inventory.import.events in apps/ai-worker/import_worker.go, claims sessions into DISCOVERING, streams first-50-row samples from GCS, runs provider-agnostic mapping through packages/ai-bridge (InventoryMapper with Vertex Gemini token counting + deterministic/fallback header logic), persists DISCOVERED or MAPPING_REQUIRED with anomaly summaries into SupplierImportSessions/SupplierImportMapping, and emits INVENTORY_IMPORT_STATUS_UPDATE for supplier websocket IMPORT_STATUS fanout.
Session mapping, approve, and apply handlers now persist staged-row lifecycle state and counters instead of returning not-implemented stubs.
Suppliercoreroutes import sandbox handlers expose /v1/supplier/inventory/imports for session init/status/mapping/approve/apply and enforce supplier_id from JWT scope only.
Staged import mapping audit writes use BULK_IMPORT_STAGED and phase-6 production apply writes use BULK_IMPORT in InventoryAuditLog.

Admin portal now exposes supplier bulk-import ingress shells at /supplier/inventory/import and /inventory/import with upload-ticket, session, rows, mapping, approve, apply, status, direct signed-URL upload, uploaded bridge signal, and processing scanner/skeleton states.

Import finalize flow carries import_session context and optional single-warehouse focus so attribution review opens directly in analytics.
SupplierImportAnalyticsFacts now stores additive per-apply counters (applied_rows, quantity_delta, session_count, last_session_id, last_applied_at) in the same transaction as inventory dual-writes.
Warehouse analytics and portal now surface import freshness telemetry without changing existing warehouse revenue/order KPI contract fields.

notes: DeliverySessions and DeliverySessionAdjustments are additive schema surfaces keyed by SessionId with order/driver/retailer/supplier indexes for realtime and audit queries.
VerifyHandshake supports signed JWT tokens with fallback to the existing delivery token path for compatibility while enforcing geofence and assignment checks.

ConfirmOffload now transitions session state to SETTLEMENT_AWAIT and emits SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED; orderroutes websocket fanout emits additive SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED plus legacy PAYMENT_REQUIRED for deployed clients.

Kafka notification dispatcher now consumes DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED and projects settlement/session numeric fields onto websocket frames so retailer modal consumers receive amount/session parity during fanout delivery.

Treasury invoice status override now emits DELIVERY_DISPUTED via transactional outbox on DISPUTED transitions, and notification dispatcher consumes DELIVERY_DISPUTED for supplier manual-review fanout.

Retailer desktop, iOS, and Android clients now consume SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED directly and treat DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED as additive amount or refresh signal to keep payment and order views converged during settlement.
Active fulfillment query now includes AWAITING_PAYMENT with legacy AWAITING_GLOBAL_PAYNT compatibility to prevent payment-waiting rows from dropping from retailer fulfillment surfaces.
CompleteOrder now blocks completion while delivery-session settlement is still pending (uncleared PaymentClearedAt on active session states).
Payment session settlement and cash collection completion now advance matching delivery sessions to FINAL_SETTLEMENT and record PaymentClearedAt to release delivery lock semantics.
GET returns an additive superset order-detail payload with line items.
GET /v1/orders/{id}/events returns the scoped OrderEvents audit timeline for the same compatibility surface.
PATCH accepts both /status and /state path aliases.
PATCH accepts either status or state in the request body for legacy compatibility.
Unified checkout emits ORDER_VALIDATION_FAILED, PAYMENT_CLEARED, and ORDER_FINALIZED to kafka.TopicMain through transactional outbox, replacing the stale topic.orders.v1 path.

Unified checkout now resolves supplier-effective currency through countrycfg.Service and applies that currency to MasterInvoices, Orders, OrderLineItems, and checkout outbox payloads, with a temporary 422 guard when one checkout payload spans mixed supplier currencies.

Unified checkout, B2B checkout, and retailer card checkout now resolve supplier-effective gateway lists from region defaults plus supplier country override exceptions with vault-backed credential readiness filtering, so payment_gateway is treated as an optional client hint instead of the source of truth.

Card checkout, B2B checkout, and unified checkout responses now include additive policy metadata fields (resolved_gateway, policy_source, allowed_gateways, policy_reason) to support migration-safe clients while preserving legacy gateway/payment_url contracts.

Gateway policy violations now return structured JSON metadata in B2B, unified, and retailer card-checkout paths, including requested_gateway, resolved_gateway, policy_source, allowed_gateways, and policy_reason.
MasterInvoices writes now persist additive SettlementTarget values (GLOBAL_SUPPLIER, LOCAL_WAREHOUSE, MIXED_WAREHOUSE) across unified/card/cash checkout flows.
Unified checkout now mirrors effective stock decrements into SupplierInventoryV2 for warehouse-assigned plans while preserving SupplierInventory locks for backward-compatible contention control.
payment/session.go now honors CreateSessionRequest.Currency and preserves the prior session currency during RetryPaymentSession gateway switches.
payment/provider.go now centralizes gateway resolution for GLOBAL_PAY, ADYEN, and CASH; ADYEN resolves to payment/adyen.go (official adyen-go-api-library/v21 Payment Links hosted checkout adapter).

payment/session.go create/attempt/bind/retry paths now normalize gateway values through NewProviderClient, checkout URL generators fail closed for unsupported/unavailable providers, and payment/webhooks.go validates session gateway compatibility through the provider resolver before Global Pay settlement.

payment/execution.go now adds ProviderExecutionRouter plus normalized stored-method charge, authorize, capture, void, and refund contracts so order/service.go, order/unified_checkout.go, and payment/refund.go can reuse one direct-execution seam instead of embedding Global Pay logic inline.

order/service.go now initializes Adyen hosted checkout links and routes Global Pay retailer checkout, fulfillment saved-card charge, and authorization-void release through the provider execution seam, while direct Adyen charge/refund paths remain explicitly unsupported via ErrAdyenDirectOperationUnsupported.

Refund and chargeback compatibility paths now accept additive amount+currency input while preserving amount_uzs contracts; refund responses include additive amount+currency fields, and anomaly currency writes now resolve from runtime/session currency rather than hardcoded UZS.

paymentroutes chargeback and chargeback-reversal handlers now emit structured application/json error envelopes (error, code, message, endpoint, deprecated), and deprecated POST /v1/payment/global_pay/initiate uses the same envelope with migrate_to guidance to /v1/order/card-checkout.
webhookroutes now mounts all gateway webhook ingress paths behind shared priority and logging middleware wrappers.

Adyen webhook processing in payment/adyen_webhook.go parses official notification envelopes, validates per-item HMAC signatures, and applies idempotency guards before settlement/failure mutation paths.
Gateway webhook handlers remain signature-first and role-unauthenticated by design.
Read queries now join Retailers and apply auth.AppendRegionFilter on the retailer alias when region scope is active.
Route composers continue to validate region_id compatibility via auth.RequireRegionScopeWithClient before handler execution.
Warehouse ops reads and demand-forecast order-side reads now join Retailers and apply auth.AppendRegionFilter on the retailer alias when region scope is active.
Route composers continue to validate region_id compatibility via auth.RequireRegionScopeWithClient before handler execution.
When no active SupplyLanes row exists for supplier plus warehouse, the optimizer now falls back to nearest active supplier factory instead of returning no candidate.
Fallback applies additive ProductTypes preference when explicit product mappings are present, and then relaxes to all active factories if no explicit mapping matches the requested product.
When warehouse coordinates are unavailable, fallback uses warehouse PrimaryFactoryId or SecondaryFactoryId before deterministic first-candidate selection.
Warehouse candidates are now ranked by H3 grid distance, with equal-ring candidates tie-broken using Redis-backed round-robin counters keyed by wh:rr:<supplierId>:<retailerCell>.
Tie-break distribution applies to both Redis grid-cell and Spanner fallback resolver paths.
When Redis is unavailable or round-robin state cannot advance, selection falls back to deterministic lexical warehouse ordering.

notes: Retailer role-row composition now includes idempotency-guarded legacy procurement create and cancel mutations while shared order list/detail/refund compatibility reads live in orderroutes.

POST /v1/retailer/cart/sync now emits CART_SYNC_UPDATED over ws/retailer post-commit, and desktop, iOS, and Android cart stores rehydrate from GET /v1/retailer/cart/sync when that signal arrives.

POST /v1/retailer/orders/{confirm-ai,reject-ai} now emits AI_ORDER_CONFIRMED/AI_ORDER_REJECTED through transactional outbox in the same Orders mutation transaction, and ORDER_REASSIGNED fanout now includes affected retailer recipients so desktop/iOS/Android order and tracking views refresh on reassignment.

Retailer desktop inbox refresh now includes SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED and DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED, iOS/Android inbox icon mappings include ORDER_REASSIGNED plus settlement/session-update event types, and packages/types/ws-events.ts now carries additive retailer ws-event contracts for ORDER_REASSIGNED, SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED, DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED, and CART_SYNC_UPDATED.

Retailer Android push fallback mapping now includes SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED and DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED in PegasusFirebaseMessagingService so settlement/session-update alerts remain visible while backgrounded or when websocket delivery is unavailable.
driverroutes now owns the driver websocket mount previously registered inline in main.go.

High-consequence driver mutations (/v1/order/deliver, /v1/order/confirm-offload, /v1/order/complete, /v1/order/collect-cash, /v1/delivery/arrive) now send deterministic Idempotency-Key headers from both Android and iOS clients for replay-safe retries.
Driver availability toggles emit DRIVER_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED inside the same Spanner ReadWriteTransaction via outbox; kafka.EmitNotification remains post-commit best-effort fanout.

Driver login/profile payloads include additive dual-node fields (home_node_type, home_node_id, driver_mode, factory metadata) so one driver app role row can operate both factory-transfer and warehouse-delivery assignments.
Factory portal shell now hydrates identity from GET /v1/factory/profile instead of static labeling.

Android and iOS clients expose additive advanced-factory endpoint methods (transfers/create, manifests detail/transition, fleet split lists, staff detail) while preserving the existing operator-loop routes.
Factory role-row realtime contract now includes GET /v1/ws/factory with additive events FACTORY_SUPPLY_REQUEST_UPDATE, FACTORY_TRANSFER_UPDATE, FACTORY_MANIFEST_UPDATE, and FACTORY_OUTBOX_FAILED.
Factory websocket envelopes include stable trace_id keys so portal and native clients can correlate refresh-triggered updates.

Payload terminal, payload iOS, and payload Android all depend on one payloader auth, manifest lifecycle, inbox, and websocket contract.
Shared supplier manifest routes and the payloader websocket now admit PAYLOADER alongside SUPPLIER and ADMIN on the paths the payload clients already consume.
SupplierTruckManifests remains the payload-facing manifest lifecycle source, keeping payload clients aligned on DRAFT, LOADING, SEALED, DISPATCHED, and COMPLETED states.
The payloader websocket now emits typed PAYLOAD_SYNC frames with channel SYNC so payload clients can refresh active manifest state without rendering blank notifications.

Supplier CRM list/detail payloads now include additive retailer email for the admin-portal contact drawer consumer.
